task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Solve MaxCut with QAOA (p=1) in Cirq for the graph [(0, 1), (0, 4), (1, 2), (1, 4), (2, 3), (3, 4)]: scan a grid of (gamma, beta) values, pick the best, sample the circuit and report the best cut. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
